title: Toronto café idea of borrowing other people's brain power

tellings.quote: it's like 2018. I'm chilling in a cafe in Toronto and I look around, right?

plain: Sitting in a café in Toronto in 2018, a researcher named Deep Prasad looked at the people around him and had an idea: what if you could borrow other people's brain power? He tells Michels this himself, as the moment the idea came to him, on an episode where he argues that artificial intelligence is a kind of alien technology.
